assertions.assertion: Configures both AddJwtBearer and AddOAuth2Introspection handlers
assertions.rationale: Configures both AddJwtBearer and AddOAuth2Introspection handlers.

assertions.assertion: Uses ForwardReferenceToken (via Selector.ForwardReferenceToken) to route reference tokens to the introspection handler
assertions.rationale: Uses a hand-rolled AddPolicyScheme ForwardDefaultSelector counting dots; Selector.ForwardReferenceToken is not used.

assertions.assertion: The scheme name passed to ForwardReferenceToken matches the scheme name used in AddOAuth2Introspection
assertions.rationale: No ForwardReferenceToken is used, so there is no scheme-name match to verify (the custom selector returns "introspection" but not via ForwardReferenceToken).

assertions.assertion: Sets ValidTypes to include 'at+jwt' on the JWT bearer handler
assertions.rationale: ValidTypes = new[] { "at+jwt" } is set on the JwtBearer handler.
